## This is my Quarto document for lecture 2

Load libraries

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(palmerpenguins)
library(ggplot2)
library(kableExtra)

```

Down here I'll make a simple plot

NOTE: THE CODE CHUNK OPTIONS HAVE TO BE EXACTLY THIS FORMAT TO WORK:

```{r}
#| label: fig-penguin-flipmass
#| fig-width: 3
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-align: "center"
#| fig-cap: "Body mass vs flipper length by species"
#| echo: false

penguins |> 
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = body_mass_g,
                       y = flipper_length_mm,
                       color = species))+
  geom_point()



```

next section - kableExtra

great for making awesome tables!


```{r}
#| label: tbl-peng
#| tbl-cap: "Table of the mean bill length highlighting chinstrap penguins"
#| echo: false
penguins |> 
  group_by(species) |> 
  summarise(billmean = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  kbl() |> 
  kable_classic() |> 
  row_spec(2, bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "red") |> 
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```


gt and gtExtra are also cool table packages
